about_the_game:
This Pack includes:

  • M4A3 (76) W HVSS Sherman (Rank 3, USA)

  • M18 Gun Motor Carriage (Rank 3, USA)

  • Skink, Tank, Anti-Aircraft, 20 mm, Quad (Rank 3, USA)

  • Premium account for 15 days

  • 1000 Golden Eagles

M4A3E8 (76) W Sherman

An American medium tank from the late-war period. This variant is fitted with a camouflage net, and beneath it are secured canisters and sandbags. This field-installed kit provided extra protection against enemy fire. Its primary armament is the 76 mm M1 gun.

M18 Hellcat

A highly mobile tank destroyer armed with the 76 mm M1 gun. This version is equipped with a lightweight camouflage net, external brackets carrying the crew’s personal gear, and an additional 7.62 mm machine gun mounted on the turret. The look is based on authentic photographs of late-production vehicles sent to Europe — the turret even bears an information plate similar to those used when rolling off the factories en route to the front.

Skink

A rare Canadian-designed anti-aircraft vehicle armed with four 20 mm automatic cannons. Extra track links are mounted on the hull, and wooden side panels echo those used on Sherman-series tanks. Its fully enclosed turret offers a high degree of crew protection, making the Skink an effective air-defense platform capable of repelling ground-attack aircraft and fighters even at close range.

Note!

  • Refund is not provided if you purchase 2 different packs which include the same vehicle or you already have the vehicle from this pack!

  • Available for Linux, Windows and Mac only. You can't activate this item for the PSN or Xbox Live account.
